✨ What's New in Version 1.2.0

• 🌐 24/7 Cloud Architecture: Migrated default server to permanent Render cloud host (https://smart-inspection-mosje.onrender.com/api/), eliminating local tunnel dependencies.

• 🔑 Universal Demo 2FA (123456): All official roles (Master Admin, Officers, Inspectors, NGOs) accept code 123456 for Google and Gov Authenticator 2FA.

• 🛡️ Resilient Authentication: Resolved invalid credential issues with unified multi-identifier matching across username, email, phone, and role.

• 🔄 Auto Cache Flush: Automatically purges expired tunnel endpoints on application launch.

📱 Easy Installation Steps

  • 1

    Download the APK

    Tap the orange "Download Release APK" button above on your Android phone.

  • 2

    Allow Unknown Sources (Standard Android Security)

    When the download completes, tap the APK in your notification bar. If prompted with "For your security, your phone is not allowed to install unknown apps", tap Settings and toggle ON "Allow from this source".

  • 3

    Install & Launch

    Tap Install. Once installed, tap Open. Select your official position and log in.

🛡️ Evidence Integrity & Security

• Camera-Only Pipeline: Gallery pickers and external file choosers are blocked for field inspections.

• Burned-In Watermark: Official MoSJE emblem logo and real-time GPS coordinates are burned directly into image pixels.

• Anti-Spoofing: Enforces GPS accuracy ≤ 100m, blocks mock locations, and validates server timestamps.

• Offline Queue: Idempotent UUID-keyed syncing prevents duplicate submissions in remote areas.

✨ Google AI Studio & Gemini Integration

• Real-time AI Copilot: Powered by Gemini 3.8 / Flash for automated inspection evaluation and policy QA.

• Tender Risk Auditing: Analyzes milestone completion, budget variance, and contract flags autonomously.

• Anti-Fraud Guidance: Real-time statutory verification of ₹472 escalation fee rules and citizen nudge quotas.
